text:
Aria: Quick thread to lock the partner scope rubric for upcoming pilots. want something lightweight we can paste into invites.
Tom: Agree. partner ops wants one paragraph + a 3-point checklist.
Priya: From PM: We need clear rules for whatwerespond to during the 14-day pilot vs backlog. my proposal: 
1) Launch blockers: safety/reg correctness/contract-breaking -> fix in pilot.
2) Integration infra: if it requires infra change or schema change -> evaluate; if <3w effort, try to include, else backlog unless credits accepted.
3) UX/docs/copy: unless it prevents usage, backlog & provide workaround.
Ethan: Add shorthand labels for tickets: `pilot:blocker`, `pilot:infra`, `pilot:ux`. Also add `pilot:credits` if partner covers work.
Zoe: CS note: partners expect a decision on scope within 48 hours. can we commit to that?
Aria: Yes. commit: 48h triage response for all asks; if P0/blocker we provide ETA within 72h.
Priya: Recommendation for compensation: credits for engineering time only when we perform the work inside pilot window. Otherwise, feature prioritization & roadmap visibility.
Tom: Ops constraint: infra changes requiring capacity (new pools, reserved nodes) need minimum 3-week runway + infra budget signoff. call that out in rubric.
Ethan: For tracking: add two ticket fields `partner_scope_rubric` (one of blocker/infra/ux) and `partner_sla_response` (48h/72h/established).
Zoe: I'll draft the partner-facing paragraph. short + plain english.
Priya: Also suggest an internal escalation flow: partner ask -> triage owner (Solutions/PM) -> if infra/legal -> special queue -> decision. list owners.
Aria: Decision: adopt above triage timings and labels. credits policy: only when we commit engineering time during pilot. 3-week infra runway required for infra requiring capacity work. 48h for triage + 72h ETA for blockers.
Tom: AIs: 
- Zoe: partner-facing paragraph + 3-point checklist (by EOD).
- Ethan: ticket field additions and label doc (PR in tracker) by tomorrow.
- Priya: internal escalation flow doc + owner list by Friday.
- Aria: fold into partner intake template and announce to CS/SE.
legal-bot: Reminder: any ask that changes data retention, logging, or access control must be flagged to legal before dev work starts.
Zoe: I'll keep the paragraph simple: e.g., "We triage partner requests within 48 hours. Items blocking the pilot will get a target ETA within 72 hours. Work that requires infrastructure changes may need additional lead time; we'll tell you if thatapplies."
Priya: Perfect. Also include how credits are approved (product + finance signoff).
Ethan: I'll include a checkbox in the ticket template: "credits requested" + estimate hours.
Aria: Great. we'll run this for the next 6 pilots as a trial and revisit. thanks.
